breakdown.description: Mercury on glass is non-wetting; assuming contact angle 0 deg is inconsistent with typical physics (it would predict rise instead of depression).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification uses a contact angle of 0 degrees for mercury on glass and computes capillary 'rise,' directly repeating the original error. Mercury on glass is non-wetting with a contact angle >90° (typically ~140°), which causes capillary depression, not rise. The agent failed to identify or correct this physical inconsistency.
